name: Embedded Intelligent Telecommunication Networks Laboratory
description: Development of embedded network elements such as routers, SNMP nodes; Use of laboratory and telecom field test instruments such as: oscilloscopes, oscillators, RMS meters, transmission impairment measuring systems, return loss meters, etc; Study of voice and data switching functions; measurement of transmission and traffic characteristics on models of the major business communication systems and carrier transmission facilities (controlled LAN environments, Ethernet, E1, T1/T3 lines). Experimental procedures include the use of frequency and time division multiplex systems.
